name: Campingplatz Seeshaupt
beschreibung: The Seeshaupt campsite is located in the village of the same name in Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the Tiroler Alpen and the surrounding forests as well as nearby bodies of water. The sanitary facilities and the supply and disposal facilities for motorhomes are available on site. The pitches are designed for motorhomes, caravans and tents. A supply kiosk and bicycle storage facilities are part of the amenities. The atmosphere on site is quiet and relaxation-oriented. The target audience is primarily families and those seeking peace and quiet who want to explore nature.
